description: This file defines the SqlQueryContext class, which manages SQL query parameters and query string building, including handling different data types and security context integration.

classes.name: SqlQueryContext
classes.description: Manages SQL query string and parameters, providing methods to add various data types and retrieve parameter info, with security context integration.

classes.name: SqlQueryContext.Parameter
classes.description: Represents a query parameter with its value, SQL type, and name.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the query, checking for duplicates and null values.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a string to the SQL query.

methods.name: hasValue
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter.

methods.name: getSqlType
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL type of a parameter.

methods.name: checkParameter
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a parameter, throws if not set.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Gets the type name of a parameter.

methods.name: getParameterNames
methods.description: Returns all parameter names.

methods.name: addUuidParameter
methods.description: Adds a UUID parameter.

methods.name: addStringParameter
methods.description: Adds a String parameter.

methods.name: addDoubleParameter
methods.description: Adds a double parameter.

methods.name: addLongParameter
methods.description: Adds a long parameter.

methods.name: addStringListParameter
methods.description: Adds a list of Strings as a parameter.

methods.name: addBooleanParameter
methods.description: Adds a boolean parameter.

methods.name: addUuidListParameter
methods.description: Adds a list of UUIDs as a parameter.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the constructed SQL query string.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves tenant ID from security context.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves customer ID from security context.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves entity type from security context.

methods.name: isIgnorePermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if permission check should be ignored based on security context.
